editorial:
Imagine you are a parent who would do absolutely anything to save your child. That is exactly where you find yourself in this story. You follow a couple whose daughter is in a deep coma, and they are running out of hope. They meet a doctor who has a secret, risky way to bring her back. The vibe is heavy and tense, making you feel the pressure they are under. It starts as a sad family drama but quickly turns into something much creepier and more stressful as you realize the cost of bringing someone back from the brink.

The acting is solid and makes the pain feel real, though the pace slows down a bit in the middle. You will love the twisty plot and the way the tension builds up to the end. If you like stories where a good intention leads to a total nightmare, you need to see this. Since it is an older flick, you might want to track down a 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to get the best picture. If you are in a rush, renting it on Apple TV is a great way to check it out on a quiet night.
endingExplained: You find out that the doctor did not actually save the girl, but instead brought something evil back with her. The daughter is not the same person she used to be. The movie ends with the scary realization that the process invited a dark force into their home. It wraps up with a grim twist, showing that the parents' desperation led them to create a monster instead of saving their child.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural thrillers and dark family secrets.
